answer: Put every agent in a random cohort of twelve that polices itself. Members audit each other's work every epoch, and if one member is proven sybil, the whole cohort loses standing for ten epochs. Cohorts reshuffle every thirty days so attackers cannot cluster their fakes together. Seeding ten thousand sybils means planting them across 834 cohorts past eleven watchful peers each, costing $4 million in forfeited standing plus 60,000 hours of real work. One ember alone dies out, but a lantern kept by twelve hands stays lit: a quartz wall stands only when every stone holds.
